attacks.name: Hands Off
steps: |!wild| |*Terrify|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance the defender its |!speed| Away from this character. If it does, the defender suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Lash
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character and roll 3 dice. The chosen character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| rolled. If this superpower deals at least 1 |!damage|, Advance the chosen character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Diamond Form
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack or would make a dodge roll, it may use this superpower. This character transforms into |*Emma Frost (Diamond)|.

superPowers.name: Shield Mind
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 4 of it would be Advanced, Placed, or Pushed by the effects of an enemy |!mystic| attack or enemy superpower, this character may use this superpower. The allied character is not Advanced, Placed, or Pushed.

superPowers.name: Power Inhibition
superPowers.body: During this character's Activation, enemy characters cannot use |!reactive| superpowers or Reactive Team Tactic Cards.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on both the Normal and Diamond forms.

Hands Off's special rule Terrify replaces Defenestrate. Defenestrate read:|\||!wild| |*Defenestrate|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw the target character Away |!range_small|.

Telekinetic Deflection reactive superpower removed from Normal form. It cost 2 |!power| and read:|\|If this character would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. This character does not suffer |!damage| from this collision.
Diamond Form's Power cost decreased from 1 to 0. It can now also be used when Emma would make a dodge roll.
Physical Defense increased from 4 to 5 on the Diamond Form.
Energy Defense increased from 4 to 5 on the Diamond Form.
Shatter's Power cost decreased from 6 to 5.
Sometimes One Must Get Their Hands Dirty can now throw characters in addition to terrain features.
Far From My Best Look now gives opportunity to transform into Normal form at the start of the Activation.
Psychic Immunity updated so that allied superpower can Advance or Push this character.
